On your computer, open DeskLink and choose Pair a phone. Then scan the code it shows.
Paired with %1$s. Add another computer the same way.
Tap Send files, or share a photo or file to DeskLink from any app.
Copy on one, paste on the other
What you copy on %1$s arrives here. Tap Send clipboard to send what you copied on this phone.
See your computer\'s screen on the phone
Open Desk screen to watch %1$s, and use this phone as its touchpad and keyboard.
Use the phone as a second screen
In Desk screen, choose Extend. This phone becomes a second screen: drag windows onto it.
Share your phone\'s screen to the computer
%1$s shows this phone\'s screen in a window.
This phone\'s notifications show on %1$s, and you can reply from there.
Open a terminal on %1$s from here, or pick up one you started there.
Write a note here and it shows on %1$s too.
Lost this phone? Ring it from %1$s, even when it is on silent. From here you can ring %1$s.
Lock %1$s from here. To unlock it with this phone, turn that on in DeskLink on %1$s.
Glide: the mouse moves onto the phone
Move %1$s\'s mouse past the edge of its screen and it carries on here.
Add DeskLink tiles to Quick Settings. For widgets, touch and hold your home screen, then tap Widgets.
On a GNOME computer, DeskLink can sit in the top bar: send files, ring or lock in one click. Turn it on in DeskLink on the computer.
Put both on the same Wi-Fi, and check that the computer\'s firewall lets DeskLink in. Then let DeskLink run in the background on this phone.
